title: TRE 3.0 (2024) · Class 11–12 Computer Science · Set E
subject: BPSC TRE PYQ
topic: Complete official question booklet of the BPSC Teacher Recruitment Exam 3.0 for Senior Secondary (Class 11–12) Computer Science, held on 22 July 2024. Part I Language (English 1–8, Hindi 9–30, qualifying), Part II General Studies (31–70) and Part III Computer Science (71–150): digital logic, data structures, algorithms, C, operating systems, DBMS, networking, software engineering, OOP, web, IoT, AI and e-commerce.
description: All 150 questions of booklet series E exactly as printed, with answers taken from the BPSC final answer key released on 17 October 2024. Questions 52 and 69 were deleted by BPSC and score as correct whatever you mark. Every question has five options: A to C plus 'More than one of the above' and 'None of the above'. Part I is qualifying only in the real exam and the Urdu/Bengali alternatives to Hindi are omitted here.

questions.question:
[Part I · English Language · Q.E-1]
Directions (Q. Nos. E-1 to E-5): Read the passage given below and answer the questions that follow.

Kerala is just the place for you if you love variety. There is something here to please everyone. You are sure to fall in love with the serene beauty of Kerala's magical backwaters. When you have experienced that, you can sample the excitement of Kerala's bustling cities or retreat into the villages to see at first-hand how time can stand still. Better still, take a trip to the spice gardens in the hills, to inhale the fragrance of fresh cardamoms. If that makes your tastebuds tingle and fills you with dreams of food, you need not worry. Kerala's cuisine is known for its spicy hot flavours. The coconut and the spices give the food, especially the seafood, a pungency that is enhanced by tamarind. Your meal would be incomplete without appam, rasam, fish curry and some delicious payasam. To wash it down, sip the naturally refreshing water of a tender coconut. And when you have had your fill, move into the markets to shop for gold, handicrafts, spices, cashew nuts and coffee. Bargain-hunters will never have a problem since English is spoken and understood everywhere in Kerala.

Why is Kerala just the place for you if you love variety?
options: There is something here to please everyone
More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): D.

[Part I · English Language · Q.E-8]
If 30th April is Tuesday, what day of the week would be 10th May?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): E. 30 April is Tuesday, so 7 May is Tuesday and 10 May is Friday, which is not among the options.

questions.question:
[Part I · Hindi Language · Q.H-9]
निम्नलिखित अपठित गद्यांश के आधार पर प्रश्न सं. H-9 से H-14 तक के प्रश्नों के उत्तर दिये जायें।

रतन और अजय एक ही स्कूल के छात्र थे। रतन गरीब था और अजय धनी। रतन गरीब होकर भी पढ़ने में तेज था। सभी शिक्षक उसके व्यवहार से प्रसन्न रहते थे। इसके विपरीत अजय बहुत नटखट था। पढ़ने के बदले खेलने-कूदने और बदमाशी में अधिक मन लगाता था। रतन और अजय दिली दोस्त थे। इसलिए रतन अजय को अच्छा छात्र बनने के लिए सलाह देता था। अजय शिक्षकों की बात नहीं मानता था। एक बार रतन से नाराज होकर अजय भाग रहा था। रतन ने दौड़कर अजय को रोकना चाहा। इतने ही में एक मोटर के नीचे वह गिर गया।

रतन ने दौड़कर अजय को क्यों रोकना चाहा?
options: रतन अजय से प्यार करता था
रतन और अजय एक ही स्कूल में पढ़ते थे
एक बार रतन से नाराज होकर अजय भाग रहा था
उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): C.

questions.question:
[Part I · Hindi Language · Q.H-15]
निम्नलिखित अपठित गद्यांश के आधार पर प्रश्न सं. H-15 से H-20 तक के प्रश्नों के उत्तर दिये जायें।

शिवाजी भारत के महान् वीरों में से एक थे। उनका उद्देश्य महाराणा प्रताप के उद्देश्य से भी उच्च था। वे अपने कार्यों में सफल रहे। वे केवल वीर ही नहीं, बल्कि एक अच्छे राजनीतिज्ञ भी थे। उन्होंने लोगों में एक राष्ट्र की भावना भर दी और मराठा राज्य की स्थापना की। वे कट्टर हिन्दू थे तो भी दूसरे के धर्म और संस्कृति का आदर करते थे। उनके अच्छे गुणों के कारण सभी लोग उनका आदर करते थे। हम लोगों को उनके जीवन से शिक्षा लेनी चाहिए।

शिवाजी वीर होने के साथ और क्या थे?
options: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): A.

शिवाजी भारत के महान् वीरों में से एक थे। उनका उद्देश्य महाराणा प्रताप के उद्देश्य से भी उच्च था। वे अपने कार्यों में सफल रहे। वे केवल वीर ही नहीं, बल्कि एक अच्छे राजनीतिज्ञ भी थे। उन्होंने लोगों में एक राष्ट्र की भावना भर दी और मराठा राज्य की स्थापना की। वे कट्टर हिन्दू थे तो भी दूसरे के धर्म और संस्कृति का आदर करते थे। उनके अच्छे गुणों के कारण सभी लोग उनका आदर करते थे। हम लोगों को उनके जीवन से शिक्षा लेनी चाहिए।

शिवाजी कौन थे?
options: भारत के महान् वीरों में से एक
उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): B.

questions.question:
[Part I · Hindi Language · Q.H-18]
निम्नलिखित अपठित गद्यांश के आधार पर प्रश्न सं. H-15 से H-20 तक के प्रश्नों के उत्तर दिये जायें।

लोग शिवाजी का आदर क्यों करते थे?
options: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): C.

options: वह नीति जिससे राज्य का संचालन होता है
वह नीति जिससे शासन का संचालन होता है
उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): E.

questions.question:
[Part II · General Studies · Q.31]
Which of the following is the value of (x + 1/x)²?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): E. (x + 1/x)² = x² + 2 + 1/x². None of the listed expansions has the +2 term.

questions.question:
[Part II · General Studies · Q.32]
An article is marked at 10% more than the CP. If a discount of 10% is allowed, then which of the following is right?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): B. Marked price 110, less 10% = 99, so a 1% loss on the cost price of 100.

questions.question:
[Part II · General Studies · Q.33]
By what number should 81 be divided to get a perfect cube?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): A. 81 ÷ 3 = 27 = 3³.

questions.question:
[Part II · General Studies · Q.34]
The difference between two whole numbers is 66. The ratio of the two numbers is 2 : 5. The two numbers are:
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): E. 2k and 5k with 3k = 66 gives k = 22: the numbers are 44 and 110.

questions.question:
[Part II · General Studies · Q.35]
In a parallelogram ABCD, angle A and angle B are in the ratio 1 : 2. Find the angle A.
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): C. Adjacent angles of a parallelogram add to 180°, so A = 60°.

questions.question:
[Part II · General Studies · Q.36]
The height of a cylinder whose radius is 7 cm and the total surface area is 968 cm² is:
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): A. 2πr(r + h) = 968 with r = 7: 44(7 + h) = 968, so h = 15 cm.

questions.question:
[Part II · General Studies · Q.37]
If (–3)^(m+1) × (–3)⁵ = (–3)⁷, then the value of m is:
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): C. (–3)^(m+1) × (–3)⁵ = (–3)^(m+6) = (–3)⁷, so m = 1.

questions.question:
[Part II · General Studies · Q.38]
If x and y are inversely proportional, then:
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): B.

questions.question:
[Part II · General Studies · Q.39]
A piece of wire of resistance R is cut into 5 equal parts. These parts are then connected in parallel. If the equivalent resistance of the combination is R', then the ratio R/R' is ________
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): C. Each part is R/5; five in parallel give R/25, so R/R' = 25.

questions.question:
[Part II · General Studies · Q.40]
An electric heater of resistance 8 Ω draws 15 A current from a service mains for 2 hours. What will be the rate at which heat is developed in the heater?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): E. P = I²R = 15² × 8 = 1800 W, which is not among the options.

questions.question:

Which of the following lenses would you prefer to use while reading small letters found in the dictionary?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): E. A convex lens of short focal length works as a magnifier; a 50 cm convex lens is too weak, so BPSC keyed 'none of the above'.

questions.question:
[Part II · General Studies · Q.48]
In which of the following countries did India launch its UPI?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): C. UPI was launched in Mauritius and Sri Lanka in February 2024; Mauritius is the option BPSC keyed.

questions.question:

questions.question:

Digital circuit can be made by the repeated use of the ________.
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): D. NAND and NOR are both universal gates, so more than one option is correct.

questions.question:
[Part III · Computer Science · Q.72]
Which of the following is correct for Digital Circuits?
options: They use analog signals for communication
They process information using continuous voltage levels
They are not suitable for high speed operations
More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): E. All three statements are false; digital circuits use discrete levels and are suited to high speed.

questions.question:

Which of the following is an example of a digital electronic device?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): D.

questions.question:

An OR gate has 4 inputs. The number of words in the truth table will be ________.
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): C. A 4-input gate has 2⁴ = 16 rows (words) in its truth table.

questions.question:
[Part III · Computer Science · Q.75]
When does a negative level triggered flip-flop in Digital Electronics change its state?
options: When the inputs are all zero
More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): A.

questions.question:
[Part III · Computer Science · Q.76]
What is the result of the operation 1010 AND 1100 in binary?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): A. 1010 AND 1100 = 1000.

questions.question:
[Part III · Computer Science · Q.77]
In a half-adder circuit, what are the outputs?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): A.

questions.question:
[Part III · Computer Science · Q.78]
Which of the following is a type of Read Only Memory (ROM)?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): D. PROM, EPROM and MROM are all kinds of ROM.

questions.question:
[Part III · Computer Science · Q.79]
What is a PLA?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): B.

questions.question:
[Part III · Computer Science · Q.80]
How many select lines are required for an 8-to-1 multiplexer?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): B. An 8-to-1 multiplexer needs log₂8 = 3 select lines.

questions.question:
[Part III · Computer Science · Q.81]
Convert the decimal number 1234 to binary, octal, and hexadecimal. Which of the following options correctly represents these conversions?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): A. 1234 = 10011010010₂ = 2322₈ = 4D2₁₆.

questions.question:
[Part III · Computer Science · Q.82]
What is Booth's algorithm used for?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): C.

questions.question:
[Part III · Computer Science · Q.83]
Which of the following is an error detection code used in digital logic?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): D. Hamming code, CRC and checksum are all error-detection codes.

questions.question:
[Part III · Computer Science · Q.84]
When performing BCD addition, what is the maximum value that can be represented in a single BCD digit?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set E): E. One BCD digit ranges 0 to 9, so the maximum is 9, which is not listed.

questions.question:
[Part III · Computer Science · Q.85]
